statement: For a bounded nonnegative shift-invariant positive-definite kernel k(x,y)=Psi(x-y), Psi(0)=K>0, NAMMD=MMD^2/(4K-||mu_P||^2-||mu_Q||^2) lies in [0,1]. At fixed MMD^2 it is nondecreasing in the sum of the squared embedding norms, and its separated concentrated limit is one.
assumptions: P and Q are probability measures
acceptance: All analytic inequalities hold, all numerical cases lie in [0,1], the exact rational checker reaches both endpoints, and the mutated denominator fails.
